answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the bridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the orchard of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
